description: This file defines the interface IBatchContainer used in Orleans streaming to represent a batch of heterogeneous, ordered stream events, allowing querying of events by type, access to stream and sequence identifiers, and modification of the request context before delivering the batch.

classes.name: IBatchContainer
classes.description: Interface representing a container for a batch of stream events, providing methods for retrieving events, identifiers, and modifying request context.

methods.name: StreamId
methods.description: Gets the stream identifier for the stream this batch is part of.

methods.name: GetEvents
methods.description: Retrieves events of a specific type from the batch.

methods.name: SequenceToken
methods.description: Gets the stream sequence token for the start of this batch.

methods.name: ImportRequestContext
methods.description: Allows the batch to modify the RequestContext before sending to consumers.
